name: Echo
label: Echo
summary: Echo's catalog and operator manuals are unusually direct about chain: the bars-and-chains chart gives the bar part number, chain part number, drive-link count, gauge, pitch and file size for each saw, and Echo sells matching loops under its own part numbers such as 72LPX70CQ. The 3/8″ full-size and 3/8″ low-profile families are easy to confuse across the CS-400 and CS-590.
